_comment: Round 3 (docs/plans/rainmaker-format-round3.md) golden-render baseline. html_sha256 is environment-independent (no wall-clock/system-font dependency) and asserted exactly. pdf_pages reflects a real WeasyPrint render (Homebrew cairo/pango) and is only asserted when WeasyPrint is importable, mirroring test_render_rainmaker_uses_pdf_engine_when_available's skip pattern. Regenerate deliberately (via the A0 golden_render scratch script) whenever the template/view intentionally changes — a silent diff here means an unintentional formatting regression, not a test to 'fix' by updating blindly.
